versions.changelog:
Initial release of Proactive Agent Lite – adds proactive core capabilities to AI agents.

- Introduces memory architecture with pre-compaction flush to retain context.
- Implements reverse prompting for surfacing unrequested ideas.
- Adds self-healing patterns for automatic diagnosis and recovery.
- Includes security hardening with safe defaults.
- Provides alignment systems to ensure mission focus and user-centric behavior.
- Seamlessly integrates with OpenClaw agents, no additional configuration required.
